title: example 287 fixed-guard: its receipt bundles the raw streams and says why its controls didn't start (review item 5)
description: The user's review item 5 of 2026-11-15 (llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md, Progress): ingestion now copies each record's stdout and stderr and the runner's controls.json and verifier.json into the receipt's records/, each cut to 512 KiB, with records/streams.json giving every one's source, whole size and sha256, and a not-started stage gives its reason. Task fixed-guard of example 287 is the case the item names: its adapter doesn't call its target BCrypt.checkpw(byte[], String), so runtime runs no controls for it, and its receipts so far didn't say why. Step 1 is VF-027's unchanged rerun (workflow_refusal.py 287 fixed-guard: claim 2fc462942f0992af, native, strict, expected established, refused as predicted at the String parameter), which leaves one unresolved receipt. Step 2 reads that receipt offline with examples/tools/targets/receipt_streams.py and exits 1 unless every stage's stdout and stderr, records/controls.json and records/verifier.json are in its bundle and each not-started control stage's reason names the adapter not calling the target. No claim, expectation or verdict changes.
expected: Step 1 prints 'refused as predicted' and exits 0 (the claim stays unresolved under key 2fc462942f0992af); step 2 prints 'receipt streams bundled', with each jvm-control stage not-started and its reason saying the adapter doesn't call the task's target
